reply.text: The good kind of sore is a fair report, and I'd like to see what you actually did before I say much more. Let me pull up today's session. Nothing is logged for today yet, so I can't see what you trained. If you did a session, it may not have been saved to the app. Tell me the lifts you did and I'll tell you what they hit. If you're heading in later, I can also check your program for the day. And a quad soreness that feels good is still just soreness; if it turns into anything sharp or lingering, that's one for a doctor or physio.
